title: Maximum subarray
summary: Return the largest sum of any run of consecutive elements in `nums`.
hints: Suppose you already know the best sum of a run that ends exactly at position i - 1. What are your only two choices for a run that ends at position i?
A run ending at i either extends the best run ending at i - 1 or starts fresh at i. Extending is only worth it when the earlier sum is positive.

Keep `current` (the best sum ending here) and `best` (the best seen anywhere). For each number: current = max(number, current + number), then best = max(best, current). Start both at the first element, not at 0.
takeaway: This is the simplest dynamic programming idea: the answer for position i depends only on the answer for i - 1. O(n) instead of O(n^2). Starting `best` at 0 is the classic bug; it breaks on all-negative input.
